statement: Secure passwordless methods are used for user authentication and authorization when feasible, otherwise strong passwords with phishing-resistant MFA is used.

source.query: GET /api/v1/policies?type=authentication ; assert every policy in scope requires FIDO2/WebAuthn or PIV, and no policy permits SMS or TOTP as a sole second factor

rationale: All 4 authentication policies in scope enforce phishing-resistant MFA (FIDO2 or PIV). No exceptions or legacy factors found.
